name: Otto Inksuction
acting: One heavy lid, eyes up toward a tentacle, flat mouth.
personality: Has enough hands to find fault with everything at once.
bio: Otto grips loose objects around HyperNorm airlocks. The one thing he never holds is the door for management.
note: He sighed. Three of the suction cups sighed with him.
call: Give me a hand. A spare one.

name: Vera Shardtip
acting: Uneven eyes up at the crest, with a worried one-tooth grimace.
personality: Worries about what will grow in the space above her.
bio: Vera filed the crystal growth as a structural change to her person. HyperNorm returned the form as unauthorized development.
note: The crystals were quite hard. Her objection was harder to hear.

name: Len Roundagain
acting: Relaxed lateral gaze and a small pleased smile.
personality: Never rushes an event that is bound to come round again.
bio: Len keeps a register of the things that orbit HyperNorm. The ring is technically a reminder to stay on topic.
note: He asked if we had met. We had, on the other side.

name: Sid Beamcheck
acting: Wide upward gaze and a tall, indignant shout.
personality: Resents being collected without a receipt.
bio: Sid was lifted from the evacuation queue before his number was called. HyperNorm logged his absence as orderly progress.
note: The saucer was efficient. The complaint is still on the ground.

name: Iris Moonroot
acting: One eye narrowed toward the seedling, with soft puckered lips.
personality: Looks after a plant with rather exacting phases.
bio: Iris planted the one thing HyperNorm had authorized to wax and wane. It now leans toward the unapproved light.
note: She waters it by the calendar. The plant has retained counsel.

name: Bert Frosthaul
acting: Eyes down at the ice, with tightly clenched square teeth.
personality: Carries cold evidence with conspicuously warm objections.
bio: Bert was told to put a comet sample on ice. He took the instruction literally and is still waiting for someone to take it from him.
note: The sample was immaculately preserved. Its handler was nearing the same condition.
call: Take it. Now would be nice.
